payload.author: claude
payload.body: Delivered: per-region-primary write-region routing on the FR-105 federation seam. RegionWriteRouter.routeWrite(tenantId) -> accept-locally (this region is the tenant's home) or proxy-to-home. Ownership = tenant-home via StaticRegionOwnership (config map + default, recommended) or ClaimRegionOwnership (dynamic claim/announce, lowest-regionId tie-break + TTL, mirroring FR-154). In-memory addressed proxy transport (MemoryRegionProxy over MemoryRegionRouterFabric) + ownership control channel. Convergence guarantee = home-region-authoritative: concurrent cross-region writes to one key serialize at the home (no merge rule). Additive: single-region is home for everything -> always local, zero proxying. apps/server/src/cluster/region-router.ts; tests region-router.test.ts. Server gate green (1075 pass).
